Source: [1730](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/1730); edited 2022-12-21. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

- Source explicitly warns these are animated effects; static screenshots do not show their full appearance.

<a id="wiki-1730-n2"></a>

- Catalog supplies friendly/enemy previews for 20 kinetic effects spanning grenade/explosion/impact/landing effects (Ana, Ashe, Baptiste, Bastion, Doomfist, Junkrat, Cassidy, Pharah, Reinhardt, Sigma, Widowmaker, Winston, Wrecking Ball).

- December 2022 catalog includes names from retired abilities such as Rising Uppercut and Tank Cannon; asset names are not proof corresponding hero ability remains available.

- Remote previews not viewed; archive provides names and view variants but little textual visual description.

Offline scope: Remote visual/audio previews are not available as offline factual text. Behavioral notes and named API assets are retained; no visual matching or numeric bounds are inferred from absent media.
